The test image shows a seedling at soil level that has collapsed with brown, soft-rotted tissue at the cotyledon/hypocotyl area, with soil sticking to the dying plant material. The plant has completely failed to establish.

The Pythium damping-off reference confirms this pattern: seedlings with rotted brown hypocotyls at soil level, plants unable to stand, brown soft rot with soil adherence. The test image matches this exactly — collapsed seedling, brown cotyledons/hypocotyl at soil surface, wet soil context.

This is clearly a pre/post-emergence damping-off scenario. The other candidates (Diaporthe, Soybean_rust, etc.) affect mature plants differently.
